name: Sony BRAVIA XR-55A80K
summary: Sony BRAVIA XR-55A80K ships with an ACR viewing tracker, Sony ads and shop mode. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with a backup and undo.
intro: This 2022 Sony OLED runs Google TV on Android 12. It ships with a viewing tracker that identifies what is on screen, telemetry and remote support, Sony ads and recommendations, and a demo or shop mode. The list also covers a voice assistant and apps off by choice.

The Sony parts that drive HDMI, the tuner, the Input overlay, Bravia Sync, updates and the remote's app buttons are kept. Many UK broadcaster launchers come switched off from the factory on this set. TidyTV turns these off from your phone over Wi-Fi, saves a backup first and never deletes anything.
keep: Chromecast built in and AirPlay and HomeKit
Sony IP control, which Home Assistant needs
The HDMI, tuner and Bravia Sync services
notes: The voice assistant is off by choice here. The remote's mic button stops working.
The remote's Netflix, YouTube, Prime Video and Disney+ buttons keep working after the stock home screen is off. YouTube, Prime Video and Disney+ share one key code, so remapping one needs care.
The remote's Settings button does nothing once the stock home screen is off, until a helper service is on.

faq.q: Will the voice button still work on my Sony BRAVIA?
faq.a: Not with the default list, because the voice assistant is off by choice. Switch it back on in the app if you use voice.

faq.q: Will Home Assistant still see my TV?
faq.a: Yes. Sony IP control is kept, and without it Home Assistant shows the TV as off.

faq.q: Will it stop the viewing tracker?
faq.a: Yes. The ACR viewing tracker is the first group on the list.
